name: Annabel Maidgarden
original_name: アナベル・メイドガーデン
source:
My childhood friend is my fiancée and my… maid!?


It was the day before summer break. On that day, the protagonist, [url=/c89055]Kuzuhara Kei[/url], was given an astonishing instruction from his father:

“You have a fiancée. Go greet her.”

Kei, still harboring unrequited feelings for his childhood friend [url=https://vndb.org/c88841] Annabel [/url] , proceeded to the meeting place planning to decline the marriage proposal. But waiting there for him was… Annabel in maid clothes.

“I’m your fiancée, and from today on you’re my master♪”

And so, this summer break Kei began living together with Annabel.

The girl that was his childhood friend, close friend, and unrequited love had become his childhood friend, close friend, fiancée, and… maid!
translation:
我的青梅竹马，既是未婚妻，又是我的……女仆！？


距离暑假还有一天。这天，主人公[url=/c89055]葛原圭[/url]从父亲那里接到了一道令人震惊的指示。

“你有一位未婚妻，去打个招呼吧。”

圭一直单恋着青梅竹马[url=https://vndb.org/c88841]安娜贝尔[/url]，便打算到约定地点拒绝这门婚事。然而，等在那里的人竟是……身穿女仆装的安娜贝尔。

“我是你的未婚妻。从今天起，你就是我的主人了♪”

就这样，这个暑假，圭开始与安娜贝尔同居。

那个既是青梅竹马、挚友，又是他单恋对象的女孩，如今变成了青梅竹马、挚友、未婚妻，以及……女仆！
